017package org.apache.juneau.server.config.repository;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.FileUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.io.*;
023import java.nio.file.*;
024import java.util.*;
025
026import org.apache.juneau.config.*;
027
028/**
029 * Command that fetches configuration from a Git repository for a given project and branch.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Clones or pulls the configured Git repo, then loads application and project-specific
033 * configuration files into a map of {@link ConfigItem} values.
034 */
035public class GetConfiguration implements Command, GetValue<Map<String,ConfigItem>> {
036
037   private static final String APPLICATION = "APPLICATION";
038   private static final String PROJECT = "PROJECT";
039   private static final String EXT = ".cfg";
040
041   // Serializes pull/checkout/pull on the single shared checkout so concurrent requests cannot interleave branches.
042   private static final Object GIT_LOCK = new Object();
043
044   private final Map<String,ConfigItem> configs = new HashMap<>();
045
046   @SuppressWarnings({
047      "java:S1845" // Field name intentionally differs only by case from static field PROJECT
048   })
049   private String project;
050   private final String branch;
051
052   /**
053    * Constructor.
054    *
055    * @param project Project name.
056    * @param branch Branch name.
057    */
058   public GetConfiguration(String project, String branch) {
059      // Path variables are URL-decoded after the path is split, so an encoded '%2F' or '..' can survive (CWE-22).
060      validate("project", project, false);
061      validate("branch", branch, true);
062      this.branch = branch;
063      this.project = project;
064   }
065
066   /** {@inheritDoc} */
067   @Override
068   public void execute() throws Exception {
069
070      var config = Config.create().name("juneau-server-config.cfg").build();
071
072      var pathStr = config.get("GitServer/pathLocal").orElse(null);
073
074      var git = config.get("GitServer/gitRemote").orElse(null);
075
076      // Fail fast with a clear message when the operator has not configured the local checkout directory,
077      // rather than surfacing an opaque NullPointerException from new File(null) below.
078      if (pathStr == null)
079         throw new IllegalStateException("Required configuration 'GitServer/pathLocal' is not set.");
080
081      // Trusted operator-configured local git checkout directory (GitServer/pathLocal).
082      // Serves as the confinement root for the project/application config file lookups below.
083      var root = new File(pathStr);
084
085      var fileDefaultStr = lcr(APPLICATION).concat(EXT);
086      var fileProjectStr = this.project.concat(EXT);
087
088      // The checkout is shared, so the git operations AND the file reads must happen under one lock
089      // (otherwise another request could switch branches between checkout and read).
090      synchronized (GIT_LOCK) {
091         try (var gitControl = new GitControl(pathStr, git)) {
092
093            if (root.isDirectory()) {
094               gitControl.pullFromRepo();
095            } else {
096               gitControl.cloneRepo();
097            }
098
099            gitControl.branch(branch);
100            gitControl.pullFromRepo();
101         }
102
103         readFiles(root, fileDefaultStr, fileProjectStr);
104      }
105   }
106
107   private void readFiles(File root, String fileDefaultStr, String fileProjectStr) throws IOException {
108      // Resolve the config file names under the checkout root through the shared boundary check
109      // so a crafted project name cannot escape the repo directory (empty = file absent).
110      var fileDefault = resolveSafely(root, fileDefaultStr).orElse(null);
111      if (fileDefault != null) {
112         var lines = new String(Files.readAllBytes(fileDefault.toPath()));
113         configs.put(APPLICATION, new ConfigItem(lines));
114      }
115
116      var fileProject = resolveSafely(root, fileProjectStr).orElse(null);
117      if (fileProject != null) {
118         var linesProject = new String(Files.readAllBytes(fileProject.toPath()));
119         configs.put(PROJECT, new ConfigItem(linesProject));
120      }
121   }
122
123   /** {@inheritDoc} */
124   @Override
125   public Map<String,ConfigItem> get() {
126      return Map.copyOf(configs);
127   }
128
129   // Project becomes a file name, so no separators at all.  Branch is only passed to git as a ref name, so
130   // legitimate names such as "feature/foo" are allowed, but '..', backslash and NUL are not.
131   private static void validate(String name, String value, boolean allowSlash) {
132      if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.contains("\\") || value.contains("..") || value.indexOf('\0') >= 0 || (! allowSlash && value.contains("/")))
133         throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid " + name + " value.");
134   }
135}
